test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The correct answer is 'heritage'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• birthright - a particular right of possession or privilege a person has from birth.
 
• estate - an extensive area of land in the country, usually with a large house, owned by one person, family, or organization.
 
• heritage - valued objects and qualities such as historic buildings and cultural traditions that have been passed down from previous generations.
 
• settlement - an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a noun that would describe the rich traditional aspects that Indians can follow.
 
• From the meanings of the given words, it is clear that heritage fits the blank correctly. 
 
• Thus, option 3 is the correct answer. 

 

**Correct passage**__* - **Concerned and responsible Indian citizens can encourage sensible consumption (1) behaviour. This can be done by shopping less and wasting (2) even lesser; by buying local products to keep the cottage industries and (3) traditional crafts alive. In essence, by valuing their rich(4) __heritage__ and living simple and meaningful lives, Indians can set (5) a precedent and show the west that India is much more than a well of business opportunities.*
